The admissible evidence supports four points: aggregate launch readiness is above threshold and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents; there is an unresolved small-business onboarding weakness concentrated in long-context onboarding support; the current model-card draft cannot accurately say there are no known material limitations; and draft monitoring does not remove the disclosure obligation unless approved.
